question: Does the unchanged two-bank KNOW35 local memory outperform a FIT-selected online HMM and structurally matched random gate on noisy reoccurring causal laws, while preserving A after B and B after A?

source.public_tape: c=t%8; a=(t//8)%2; x=c XOR (a<<1); all 16 (c,a) with each x twice per 16 events

laws.B1: x0 XOR x2 XOR (x1 AND x2)

source.policy_observable_only: (t,x,y) after source; never seed, law, branch, phase, q or future y
source.first_use: One exact-key source-only HELD job after exact dual-OS full regression, atlas and historical compatibility, no rerun after uncertain/consumed trial. FIT and HELD sources never called by unit tests.

methods.candidate: Existing KNOW35 two-bank code unchanged; two capped six-witness Beta heads/cell; four adjacent-pair gates; likelihood switch ratio 2
methods.hmm: 16 online Beta(1,1) heads and one global 2-state Markov posterior, p(A) initially .95; initial six per-cell observations fit A, then fully online probability-weighted updates; hazard chosen on FIT only by mean Brier on treatment t64..255
methods.random_gate: Exactly same bank architecture and size as candidate but after active bank has six x witnesses switches if SHA256('know36:random-gate:v1:{t}:{x}') modulo 32 == 0, independent of seed, phase or y
methods.rolling: one last-8 window per physical input, Beta smoothed
methods.single: one online Beta per physical input
methods.fairness: Each arm sees identical public events; HMM and candidate each have 16 Beta heads but unequal computational cost, report bytes/CPU; random-gate structural capacity is matched.

metrics.scoring: Expected Brier q*(1-q)+(p-q)^2 before every update, q computed only in scorer
metrics.primary: Per-family mean prequential Brier on second B t192..255, candidate vs FIT-selected HMM and random gate; paired win counts
metrics.secondary: First B t64..127; returning A t128..191; cold exact bank retention checkpoints at t64,128,192,256; sham false switches; FIT choice; bytes; full public support; exact event counts

frozen_hypotheses.P0: FIT 12 held 24 worlds source-disjoint, exact source/model counts and no private input, 16 pair support and 8 physical cells per block; checksummed cold
frozen_hypotheses.P1: A-prefix expected Brier <= .23 for each B family, after 64 events
frozen_hypotheses.H1: Candidate reappearing B mean expected Brier <= fitted HMM minus .005 in both families, with >=9 of 12 paired wins over HMM each
frozen_hypotheses.H2: Candidate reappearing B mean expected Brier <= capacity-matched random gate minus .005 in each family
frozen_hypotheses.H3: Candidate returning A mean expected Brier <= fitted HMM +.005 in each family
frozen_hypotheses.H4: In all 24 worlds old A bank state at t64 equals t128,t192 and old B state t128 equals t192; independent cold restore at every phase boundary
frozen_hypotheses.H5: At most 2/24 control A-only worlds have any false switch after t64; candidate checkpoint <4096 bytes
frozen_hypotheses.decision: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED only if all P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4,H5 true; else DEVELOPMENT_MIXED_OR_NO_GO. SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false (synthetic only).
frozen_hypotheses.stops: No post-result threshold/seed/hazard/method changes, no HELD replay, no original #426 first use, no accepted-model integration or deployment.
